tips.text: Refine the Blueprint and Chassis relics to Radiant for 100 Void Traces each, but leave the Systems relics Intact.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
